# Nordic Crypto

> Public JSON feed of Nordic crypto news, newsletters, events, sources, academia and the who's who. No account. No API key.

Nordic Crypto covers Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Iceland. The sign-off is The Nordic Crypto team. Kaupr (kaupr.io) is a news source only and is never a sponsor. Summaries are ours, in English, with translations in summary_i18n (nn, nb, sv, da, fi, is) when published. External headlines stay in the original language.

GitHub Pages sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * on every JSON file, so a browser can fetch them from any site. Use the file name (index.json). A directory URL does not serve the JSON.

GitHub Pages base: https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/
Custom domain base (same paths at the root): https://cryptonordic.no/
Swap the base to move between the two. HTTPS on cryptonordic.no is the intended public name once the certificate matches that domain.

## Start here

- [Discovery](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/index.json): every endpoint, counts, and example URLs.
- [Human docs](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/): the same catalogue as a web page.
- [OpenAPI JSON](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.0.
- [OpenAPI YAML](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/openapi.yaml): the same document.
- [API catalog](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset. A .json copy is at https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/.well-known/api-catalog.json.
- [Site meta](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/meta.json): languages, countries, page list, CORS.

## Market prices

Prices from Nordic exchanges with a public ticker (Firi and Norwegian Block Exchange in Norway, Coinmotion in Finland). Market data, not investment advice. Each ticker has symbol, base, quote, last, bid and ask when the exchange publishes them, plus exchange id, name and country, fetched_at and source_url. Quotes are NOK, SEK, DKK or EUR. A failed exchange is an error with a timestamp and no price. The file is fetched again when the site is built, and a GitHub Actions job rewrites it on gh-pages about hourly. Durable URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jQrgen/nordic-crypto/gh-pages/api/v1/markets.json

```
curl -fsS https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/markets.json
curl -fsS https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jQrgen/nordic-crypto/gh-pages/api/v1/markets.json
```

## Fetch news and newsletters

```
curl -fsS https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/news.json
curl -fsS https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/newsletters.json
curl -fsS https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/newsletters/001.json
```

A single news item is api/v1/news/{id}.json (the id is on each item). A single newsletter issue is api/v1/newsletters/{id}.json and includes plain text and HTML. Country slices: api/v1/news/by-country/NO.json (also SE, DK, FI, IS).

## Endpoints

- [/api/v1/index.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/index.json): Discovery document: every endpoint, with example URLs.
- [/api/v1/news.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/news.json): Published news and our own stories, newest first.
- [/api/v1/news/by-country/{country}.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/news/by-country/{country}.json): Published news for one country code: NO, SE, DK, FI, IS, NORDIC or EU.
- [/api/v1/news/topics.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/news/topics.json): Topic ids present in the published news, with counts.
- [/api/v1/newsletters.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/newsletters.json): Published newsletter issues, newest first. The list omits the HTML body; the issue URL includes text and html.
- [/api/v1/events.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/events.json): Public events, soonest start first, including past events.
- [/api/v1/events/upcoming.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/events/upcoming.json): Events that have not ended, soonest first. Judged in the event's own offset.
- [/api/v1/events/past.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/events/past.json): Finished public events, newest first. Finished events stay in the archive.
- [/api/v1/events/by-country/{country}.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/events/by-country/{country}.json): Public events for one country code.
- [/api/v1/sources.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/sources.json): News outlets, the public search terms, and event sources. Kaupr is marked as a news source only.
- [/api/v1/academia.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/academia.json): Editor-approved courses, student groups, publications and research.
- [/api/v1/academia/courses.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/academia/courses.json): Academia section: courses.
- [/api/v1/academia/groups.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/academia/groups.json): Academia section: groups.
- [/api/v1/academia/publications.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/academia/publications.json): Academia section: publications.
- [/api/v1/academia/research.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/academia/research.json): Academia section: research.
- [/api/v1/academia/{id}.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/academia/{id}.json): One academia row. The id is in academia.json.
- [/api/v1/orgchart.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/orgchart.json): Published who's who: organisations, people, relations, regulation notes and caveats.
- [/api/v1/orgchart/relations.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/orgchart/relations.json): Relations between published who's who entries.
- [/api/v1/orgchart/regulation.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/orgchart/regulation.json): Short regulation status for each Nordic country, as on the who's who page.
- [/api/v1/orgchart/relations/{id}.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/orgchart/relations/{id}.json): One relation from the who's who.
- [/api/v1/profiles.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/profiles.json): Public profile links (Wikipedia, X, Wikidata and similar) for people and organisations.
- [/api/v1/images.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/images.json): Logos and photos used on the public who's who, with licence and credit.
- [/api/v1/changelog.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/changelog.json): Site changelog (product changes, not the news), newest first.
- [/api/v1/rules.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/rules.json): How EU crypto rules become law in the five countries. Simplified, not legal advice. Omitted while the page is still a placeholder.
- [/api/v1/archive/articles.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/archive/articles.json): Append-only archive of stories that have been on the public site. removed is  true when a story later left the site; the row stays.
- [/api/v1/markets.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/markets.json): Nordic exchange prices. Market data, not investment advice. Each ticker names the exchange, fetched_at and the source URL. NOK, SEK, DKK and EUR only.
- [/api/v1/markets/{exchange}.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/markets/{exchange}.json): Prices from one included exchange: firi (Norway), nbx (Norway) or coinmotion (Finland).
- [/api/v1/markets/by-asset/{symbol}.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/markets/by-asset/{symbol}.json): Prices for one asset (the base symbol, such as BTC) on every included Nordic exchange.
- [/api/v1/meta.json](https://jqrgen.github.io/nordic-crypto/api/v1/meta.json): Site name, languages, countries, page list, CORS and editorial notes.

## Not in this feed

Drafts, the editor queue, rejected stories, reader tips, newsletter subscriber addresses, analytics tokens, and private personal data are not published.
